RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 2

The panel composition doesn't help you. You're a man, the successful candidate is a man, and the panel was all men — there's no coherent theory on which your sex disadvantaged you. Raising it would read as grasping and undermine the legitimate points you do have.

Those points are stronger: you hold a master's and a professional licence against a bachelor's, you have twelve years of directly relevant municipal experience, and the stated rationale ("extensive experience of public consultation") is vague enough to invite scrutiny of whether it was weighted consistently against the posted criteria.

Chase the written explanation formally — in writing, to HR, citing any policy or statutory deadline. Silence after two weeks is the real issue.
